status: Production handoff; not a rendered or photorealism-validated video
source: Authored synthetic coordinates. Rendering ground truth is not pixel-derived detector output.
axes: x pitch length 0..105; y pitch width 0..68; z height

actions.outcome: No goal or save outcome inferred

render_requirements: Use fictional, licensed realistic humanoid assets with natural run/kick animation; no club or sponsor logos.
Render a single uninterrupted 60-second camera take from these exact transforms. No generative video restyling after rendering.
Export per-frame projection/view matrices, visible player IDs and instance masks separately from RGB footage.
Keep known coordinates and masks outside the detector input. Compare detections against them only in evaluation.
Reconcile foot contact and ball contact at each pass. Human visual approval is required; the JSON cannot certify photorealism.

acceptance.limitations: Eight-player training sequence, not a full 22-player competitive match. Final 0.1 second holds the final sampled pose.
